A Magic Resistance is allowed for each teleportation. Every 2d4 minutes, this plant molds itself into various bushes, saplings, vines, mushrooms, and flowers no larger than 4 cubic feet. Each piece held or worn by a being continues to mold shape every 2d4 minutes, assuming the form of any similar-sized object of which the user has knowledge. When the user drops or puts down the piece of Wanderstalk, it will affect the next being who touches it within the next 2d4 minutes. If nobody has touched it by then, it shifts into its natural form, a dead weed, and its magic fades.
Reduces Poison Resistance by 25% for 1d4+1 hours. Can be mixed with any poison to lower the resistance against it.
Draws water from the surrounding terrain in the following manner: Wet earth (4 gallons), Earth (1 gallon), Wet Rock (2 quarts), Plant (2 quarts), Rock (2 pints), Dry (2 cups).
Allows the user to make mental contact with a targeted being within 100' of another Weeping Mindseed tree. If the targeted being goes beyond range, the mental contact is broken.

Contains a static shield around it, stunning anyone who touches it for 3d4+3 seconds, unless a Magic Resistance is made. This static shield endures indefinitely while planted and for 1 week after being picked. A being must only make a new Magic Resistance if it leaves their Aura field and they attempt to touch it again. Anyone wearing or holding a Witherwhiff blossom will gain this static shield. Furthermore, the blossom also has a 2' radius air pocket around it full of breathable oxygen, but anyone inside the air pocket has a -2d4 Appearance, and all objects appear old and covered in rust or dirt.

Acts as a hallucinogen, unless a Magic Resistance is made, causing the user to experience a wide variety of scents, textures, tastes, and sounds, as well as a temporary -2d4 Intelligence and Wisdom. Each successive dose of Wild Scarlytte results in a cumulative -10% chance (for that attribute save) that 1 lost attribute point per dose will be permanently gone.

Allows one user who ingests half the mushroom to shroud their mind in a near complete mental copy of another user who holds the mushroom's other half. Whenever anyone mentally contacts the being who ingested, they sense the duplicated mind and not the actual mind. If the one who ingested engages or is engaged in mental combat or a strong mental connection with another being, then the herb's effect immediately fails. The being who ingested is allowed a double Perception Check to receive thoughts, emotions, and details from the being holding the other half of the mushroom that they were thinking and feeling at the time of mental duplication.

Inflicts 3d6+3 death damage to the body area touched (unless a Magic Resistance is made), but also instills the ability to locate and speak to any spirit of a being who died by drowning, as long as the user knows that being's True Name, as per the skill Speak to Dead. Wounding damage is only applied once, but the power of speaking to a drowned spirit continues for as long as the user is touching the Withersprite.

+1d4 Strength and Vitality for the duration, and envelops the user in 2 magical layers of physical armor with a combined armor rating of 30. The inner layer is considered flexible and the outer layer is semi-flexible. This magical armor will appear below any clothing or armor already worn, and weighs 30 pounds.

Creates a 20' wide sphere of suffocating darkness which negates all forms of vision. All beings within the sphere begin to choke, losing 1d6 overall Endurance per 10 seconds. At the onset of asphyxiation, a Will Force save must be made to remain calm or damage is doubled. When Endurance has been reduced to 0, a being appears very pale and must make a Vitality save every 5 seconds to remain conscious (-5% to the save for every point below 0). Once Endurance reaches a being's negative Vitality rating, the lungs have collapsed and the heart stops beating. One minute later, if Endurance is not raised above the negative Vitality rating, the being dies. A Chirugeon roll will resuscitate the suffocated being and raise overall Endurance to 1 point above negative Vitality. Should a being survive the ordeal, restoration of Endurance is based on the healing rate of the character, with minutes instead of days and a period of 10-minute intervals instead of weeks. If the being dies from suffocation, the user has a 100% chance minus the user's Will Force rating of returning as a physical undead within 10 minutes of death.
All Angels under 10th level, and Celestial Incarnates under 10th Title must make a Control Resistance to attack or even approach within 20 feet of the protected being.

Grants +5 to Endurance permanently.
Grants +10% to Magic Resistance permanently.
Restores mental and physical well-being. All negative mental and physical effects removed (as the effect Restore). However, it does not remove possession or control.

Separates the imbiber's spirit from their body for the duration of the effect. For every 2 hours of duration, the body temporarily loses one point of Vitality. This loss can kill those whose bodies are frail. After reawakening, the points return at the rate of 1 point per hour. Grants +5% to Fortune permanently.

If they die from the poison then they arrive dead, otherwise alive, though they may not stay so for long.

When consumed it allows a person to mental think of an appearance and transform into that being as the spell Change True for the duration. They are limited to beings within 1' of their normal size or weight. While the spores are on the face the Life Force of the individual wearing the spores is completely masked. They cannot be life sensed, etc.

Arastia Herb: Cause the person to have a strange sense of paranoia. The being feels they are being watched and mistrusts anyone they do not deeply love or trust. Wisdom save to see through this paranoia when requested.

Increases the imbiber's size to a random height and weight with accompying Strength bonus.
Allows the user to fly as the spell Fly. The user may carry their weight limit or less aloft with them.

Heals 3d6+3 to all areas of the body. It is magical and works against all types of damage including acid-based. lf this potion is ingested before the character takes damage, it will heal damage as it is taken, once for each area (this effect lasts only 3d6 minutes).

Grants intelligence as the spell Endow Intelligence and gives or intensifies lifeforce to whatever object or animal on which it is applied. The effects are permanent. lt has no effect on an already sapient object or creature.

Resurrects a being if they make a Will Force save. lf a being is resurrected by this potion, then he or she must rest for 1 hour per day that she was dead. It doesn't resurrect characters that have been dead for more days than they had Will Force in life.
Gives the user the following abilities: Improved Telepathy as the spell, Scrying as the spell, and Time Sight as the spell for the duration. All effects are at 20 Aura.
Grants the following for the duration: +1d4 Intelligence, and Knowledge, +4 Aura, +4 Aura Control, and 75% Thought Projection.
Grants the following for the duration: +1d4 Wisdom, Knowledge, and Piety, +20% to Commune, doubles Healing and Bless effects, and Protection from Good or Evil (100%) for duration.
Changes the imbiber into a predetermined creature for the duration as the spell Change Other (at 20 Aura).

Makes the opponent type (Animals) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made. Animals referes to any altered or magical animals over 4 Intelligence. Those non-sapients under 5 are not afforded a resistance.
Makes the opponent type (Evil aligned beings) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Good aligned beings) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Neutral aligned beings) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Angels/Archons) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Demons/Devils) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Dragons) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (All Enemies) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Giants) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Humanoids) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Supernatural) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Makes the opponent type (Undead) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Reduces the imbiber to a predetermined height for the duration.

Increases the imbiber's speed which has the following effects: imbiber always wins initiative, 2d4+2 extra seconds of action per round, -2 to be hit by physical attacks, -4 to be hit by missile attacks.

Heals 3d8+6 to all areas of the body. It is magical and works against all types of damage including acid-based. lf this potion is ingested before the character takes damage, it will heal damage as it is taken, once for each area (this effect lasts only 3d6 minutes).

Allows the imbiber to pick up objects with their mind. The total weight of all objects lifted cannot exceed 10 lb. per Intelligence point. The character can move the objects at a rate of 60' per 10 seconds.
Grants the ability to read minds for the duration, but not the ability to mentally attack.

Grants the following abilities: 2-5 Agility, invisibility 3 times during the potion's effect, +1d4 seconds of action for the entire duration, immune to poison, detect treasure in a 30' radius, and Non-detection.
Grants the following: +1d4 Strength, Agility, Vitality, +3d6 Endurance points, and Berserking 50%.

Masks user's scent, muffles user's sounds and makes the affected being invisible. These effects only relate to animals and magical animal perceptions. Magical Animals can make a Control Resistance to avoid the effects of this potion.
Grants Greater Regeneration, 1d4 points are healed per 10 seconds to all wounded areas (including vitals). Cannot regenerate from fire or acid damage or if head and heart are separated.
Conceals life force, making the imbiber undetectable to Life Sense and the like.

The mixture can be used on any non-magical stone or wood to burrow through it. Spread the mixture into the shape of a doorway, hole, or any other opening (large enough for a 6' humanoid) and let sit until it dissolves away the material.
Disguise the imbiber as a corpse due to smell and slow respiration.

When the potion is smashed or broken, the chemical and magical reaction produces a thick fog with all the properties of holy water. The fog spreads across the ground at a height of 20' and covers an area 40' in diameter. Any creatures caught inside the fog will lose all visibility unless a Magic Resistance is made. Any undead caught inside the fog will be inflicted with 3d4 damage every second they remain within. Unless the fog is blown away, it dissipates after 1 minute.

Spread the paste over the wrappings and set out until the cloth is saturated. Tie the cloth around your eyes like a blindfold. The result will be the ability to life sense up to 60' away for the duration, as long as the blindfold is worn.
The imbiber is plagued with nightmares (resulting in fatigue and even insanity) at their next sleep. Will Force save to avoid both fatigue and possible insanity.
By consuming half the potion, the drinker is allowed to phase. Consuming the second half will allow the drinker to unphase.
Allows the user to hear normal conversations but blocks sounds above a scream. If used to stop the wail or howl of a banshee, the wax 'potion' has a Magic Resistance of 30%.
Gives the imbiber protection from vampires in the form of Coexist with Undead (as the spell at 20 Aura) but only towards vampires.
Grants breathe as the potion (or the spell Breathless), Invulnerability, and Endure Cold.

Grants Magical flight, Breathe as the potion (or the spell Breathless), Invulnerability, and Endure Cold. Within 30 minutes of the potion beginning to fail, magical flight becomes Levitation (allowing only for ascent or decent).
Grants breathe as the potion (or the spell Breathless), Invulnerability, and Endure Heat.
Appear in an alternate illusionary form per the spells Illusion of Sight, Smell, Sound, Taste, Touch.
Appear to have an alternate mind per the spell Illusion of Feeling when mentally contacted, also acts as the spell Mind Set unless an Illusion Resistance is requested and made.
Acts as the spell Non-Detection for the duration.
Projects the spirit of the drinker onto an open plane of their choice. The drinker's body remains in repose, breathing but otherwise unmoving for the duration.

Physically shifts the drinker unto the Plane of Shadow. The user remains there until the duration expires then is returned to their plane of origin. This potion will not work unless the Shadow Plane is accessible from the current plane.

Causes the imbiber to make a Magic Resistance or fall into a deep, unwaking dreamless sleep. The victim cannot be woken save by magical or divine effects. The victim is also sustained as the Sustenance invocation needing neither food nor water and Breathless as the spell, appearing to be in a near suspended state, though the victim still ages.

The imbiber becomes invisible and all light of any visible wave length passes through them until they take hostile action or the duration expires. Whenever hostile action is taken there is a 10% cumulative chance of appearing. The 1st hostile action is 10%, 2nd 20%, 3rd 30%, etc.
Appear to have an alternate spirit per the spell Illusion of Feeling when felt through life sense, etc. unless an Illusion Resistance is requested and made.
Appear to have an alternate soul per the spell Illusion of Feeling when felt through life sense, etc. unless an Illusion Resistance is requested and made.
The imbiber's body no longer makes sound, except for speech when desired. Even involuntary noises are blocked.

The imbiber concentrates on a person, place, or thing and then teleports to the nearest open location within sight of it, unless that person, place, or thing is protected by magic, such as Wall of Protection, etc.
The imbiber gains True Sight as the spell and is able to see through illusions, glamours, invisibility, masked Aura, spirits, etc. for the duration.
Removes Poison, Disease, and heals 3d6 damage to all body areas.
Causes what it is used on to remain invisible so long as no strong wind blows the dust off or sudden movements shake it off.
Allows one being to fly for the duration.

The drinker breaks out in a sweat that is oily. That sweat makes the surface of the being's body more and more slippery until they cannot stand or even wear certain articles of clothing. Effect takes 10-40 seconds to fully manifest.

Does 1d4 (cold), 1d6 (fire), 1d8 (electricity) or 1d10 (acid) per Title of the invoker in a breath cone of 2' long and 1' radius at the base per Class Title of the breather. After the imbiber breathes 3 times the effect ends.

Causes auditory hallucinations with feelings of euphoria, and a 20% chance of visual hallucinations. Grants +3 to STR and VIT. -3 to all Mental Attributes. A very high pain threshold is granted reducing all damage occurrences by 2 points. Lie skill is reduced by 50%.
Grants +30% to Poison and Disease Resistance, new resistances if currently inflicted. Immune to effects which halt or alter movement and effects which cause sleep or drowsiness.
Grants +20% Disease Resistance, +1 Vitality, reduction of fever, swelling, and pain, +1d4+1 Endurance. Has very high pain threshold, reducing all damage by 2 points per occurrences.
Heals 4d6+4 damage to all body areas.
Each strip heals 1d4+1 if the wound is fresh (binding) and an additional 3d4+3 from the herbal infusion. It will also cure gangrene and blood poisoning if it is that body area.

Grants +1d4 to all physical Attributes. +20 Endurance. Immune to fear (and any control which would make someone run away). Immune to Shock. Immune to fatigue. Also counts as a full day's food and drink.
Grants +1d4+1 Intelligence, +1d4+1 Aura, +(1-2) Will Force, +1d4+1 Aura Control, and Improved Telepathy.
Grants Immunity to Cold/Heat/Electricity/Acid/Pressure and gains magical flight.
Reduces joint pain, and makes joints work more effectively. +1 temporary Agility, +10% to skills that use Agility. +10% to Agility saves.

Can Life Sense up to 60'. Immune to the draining, disease, and/or poison effects of all Undead. Cannot be sensed by undead (those with physical eyes can still see them). All undead must make a Control Resistance to approach within 20'. Even if the Control Resistance is made, they must make another to attack. All undead compulsions are suppressed by any undead within 100' of the protected individual.
+10% to Animal Lore, Tame Animal and Speak to Animal Skills for that animal type.

When brandished at the specific attuned supernatural being. They must make a Control Resistance or be banished. It can also be used to remove possession (or control) from the attuned supernatural being by placing the holy symbol charm against the Aura field of the person who is controlled or possessed, granting them a new Control Resistance. If the true name of the supernatural being is known then banishment from branding is at a -20% save and removal of possession or control allows the effected being a +20% to their Control Resistance.

One chosen boon is given to the symbol. The boon is only of the Helpful level. The symbol is then given to the recipient (which cannot be the charm's maker) and they are blessed with the boon so long as the holy symbol is kept on their person and they are not of opposite alignment or they lose favor with that deity.
Grants +10% to Control Resistance against fear effects.
Grants the bearer one Empathy Magic effect while carried.
Forces one chosen curse of Irritant level on the bearer if it is given to or hidden on the victim to take effect.

Grants the detection of 1 type (Detect Aura, Detect Curse, Detect Evil, Detect Good, Detect Magic, Detect Supernatural) by the bell ringing, crystal growing, or rock heating. The chance is the same as the charm's maker.

Rod is infused with the ability to find either crystal, metal or stone type within 1000 feet + 500 feet per full 5% of the skill roll success. The bearer can hold the rod and will feel a slight tug in the direction of the nearest source.
Rod is infused with the ability to find water. The bearer can hold the rod and will feel a gentle pull in the direction of any sources of water with 1 mile.
Grants a +20% Control Resistance to avoid being summoned or brought to the dream plane. They are also +10% to Control Resistance in general while they are asleep or unconscious.
Charged with the ability to repel Light energy. +20% to resistances against Light effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Sonic energy. +20% to resistances against Sonic effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Cold energy. +20% to resistances against Cold effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Heat energy. +20% to resistances against Heat effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Kinetic energy. +20% to resistances against Kinetic effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Electricity energy. +20% to resistances against Electricity effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Acid energy. +20% to resistances against Acid effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Aura energy. +20% to resistances against Aura effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Divine energy. +20% to resistances against Divine effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Life energy. +20% to resistances against Life effects, -1 damage per die.
Charged with the ability to repel Death energy. +20% to resistances against Death effects, -1 damage per die.
Half damage from Cold effects, gains breathless on Plane of Water.
Half damage from Fire effects, gains breathless on Plane of Fire.
Half damage from Electricity effects, gains breathless on Plane of Air.
Half damage from Acid effects, gains breathless on Plane of Earth.
Immunity to negative Light effects, healing does +1 per die rolled, gains breathless on Plane of Light/Life.
Half damage from Death effects, gains breathless on Plane of Death/Darkness.
Half damage from Chaos effects, +1 Aura Control, gains breathless on Plane of Aura/Chaos.

Grants new Control Resistance to remove all forms of control and possession. While carried by that individual it also gives a +10% Control Resistance to any attempts against them to control or possess.

Gain 1 Evoke power from the set of those the Charm maker has that can be used by anyone who carries the charm. The original skill user does not lose the ability to evoke this power themselves when they give the charm to another. The Evoke user can use a personal-use only fetish charm to gain 1 additional Evoke power from their totem animal they have not yet gained but this costs 1 full temporary Will Force loss.

Personal only charm. +20% to the following skills Body Control, and Meditate itself. They can get into the meditative state in half the usual time. They charm bearer is are also +10% to Control Resistance while attuned.

Grants the power of 1 herbal effect for the duration. If the herbal effect is of the immediate or instant type then it will occur once per hour. Example: Arnica is a healing herb. When it is placed in the Herbal Pouch charm, it automatically heals the most wounded area once per hour.
Grants the power of 1 Sympathy Magic ritual when placed on, or near the target. Effects like draining an attribute only do so once but it stays drained for the duration of the Hex Bag's efficacy.
Gives a +5%/+1 to the next action if the charm is rubbed or focused on for 5 seconds prior to the action.
Grants the power of 1 Ritual Lore effect to the bearer of the charm. GM discretion on these powers as not all will be applicable. If item is blessed it also stays blessed for the duration.

+1 Aura Control for any spell cast of one spell type only (alteration, energy, mind, etc.). No caster may carry and use more than one spell focus charm. If they have more than one in their aura field then their Aura Control is reduced by 1 (for all spell casting) for each additional charm carried over 1.
Infused with a weak power of warding against Good beings. Good enemies who attempt negative action against the bearer must make a Will Force save to do so (each time).
Infused with a weak power of warding against Evil beings. Evil enemies who attempt negative action against the bearer must make a Will Force save to do so (each time).
Infused with a weak power of warding against Supernatural beings. Supernatural enemies who attempt negative action against the bearer must make a Will Force save to do so (each time).

If a weather effect the stone is attuned to will happen later that day, the stone will behave as if affected by that weather situation, getting wet for rain, cold for wintery conditions, warm for sunny day, etc.

The bearer is considered to have a +1 starting Will Force when engaging in mental combat but only during defense portions of mental combat. Zero Will Force is still 0. When there is no remaining actual Will Force the bearer no longer gets the modifier and they lose the mental combat.

Infused with a weak power of warding against Undead beings. Undead enemies who attempt negative action against the bearer must make a Will Force save to do so (each time). Evil bearers also require undead they encounter to make Will Force saves or their undead compulsions against the being are supressed.
